signatures.description: Build an in-process HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbour index in Go that supports concurrent Insert and Delete (tombstones) without rebuilding the graph, keeping recall on the surviving set above a floor. On delete, unlink the node from every layer above 0 and repair each surviving neighbour by re-running the diversity heuristic under the degree bound M, promoting a new entry point at the highest surviving layer when the entry point itself is tombstoned. Given a seeded vector generator, a fixed insert/delete interleaving and a query set, the package must return top-k ids matching a brute-force reference at recall >= 0.95, must never return a deleted id, and must be data-race free under -race.
